country_definition: Principal base of the credited production company at the source-supported period. Do not substitute platform, commissioner, title origin, filming location, or ultimate parent country.
group_rule: Resolve every listed production tag using exact reviewed mappings; unresolved tags, absent tags or relevant disputed relationships make group unknown. Complete listed sets containing USA and another country are mixed. Listed-credit coverage is not a financing census.

matching.unknown_strata: Do not match missing language or genre. Retain as unmatched.
matching.tie_break: lexicographically first key per canonical work per stratum; all eligible works per common stratum; equal stratum weight
matching.bootstrap_unit: canonical work; sample clusters with replacement, preserve every sampled object in cluster

daily_average: trailing seven consecutive eligible daily shares, no partial-window average
timezone: Use source calendar labels as supplied; export does not certify UTC. Do not align to local audience time.

h3.cell_difference: For each elapsed interval, subtract shares only where both cells are observed. Average over common intervals; retain support count and one-sided coverage; missing cells stay null.
h3.cohort_map: Only common matched strata with identical export/geolocation versions; compare equal-work means and retain observed-cell support.
h3.finer_resolution: Not justified: source inputs are resolution 5; no subcell coordinates are inferred.

cohort_daily_rule: Use the first 56 source calendar days for every selected object. Daily cohorts require all 56 exports; audit-filtered windows and hosting exclusions are separate sensitivities. Home-country shares use the union of fully mapped listed producer countries; unresolved home country stays unavailable.
